To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the bilateral inferior and superior frontal gyri may be associated with the comprehension stage and that the cortical region in the left ventromedal prefrontal cortex as well as the subcortial regions in the bilateral amygdalas and bilateral parahipocampal gyrs may be responsible for feeling of amusement during elaboration process.

the bilateral inferior front gyri and the left superior frontal gyri may be associated with the comprehension stage of humor, whereas the cortical regions in the left ventromedical prefrontal cortex, the subcorti cal regions in the bilateral amygdalas and bilateral parahipocampal gyris may be responsible for feeling of amusement during elaboration.

comprehension of verbal jokes is associated with bilateral inferior frontal gyral activation, whereas the elaboration of verbal jokes is linked to left ventromedials prefrontal cortex activation and bilateral amygdala and bilateral parahippoocampal gyrus activation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the segregation of the comprehension-elaboration processing stages of humor.
the neural substrates that are specifically involved in the two stages of humor processing.
the neural substrates underlying the comprehension and elaborations stages of humor.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
humor comprehension is related to the left frontal lobe, while humor elaboration involves both the frontal and temporal lobes.

the comprehension of jokes involves a network of brain regions including left superior frontal gyr, left inferior frontal gyrus and bilateral parahipppocampal gyrus and the elaboration of jokes is related to bilateral amygdala, left ventromedical prefrontal cortex, and bilateral inferior frontal gyral.
humor comprehension and elaboration are two distinct cognitive processes and that the brain areas associated with these two processes are different.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
humor comprehension and humor elaboration are two separable stages of humor processing.
humor comprehension and elaboration may be mediated by distinct neural networks.
comprehension of jokes may be associated with language processing and the experience of amusement may be associated with emotional processing.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the comprehension-elaboration model of humor can be used to guide the study of the neural basis of humor processing, and the neural correlates of humor comprehension and elaboration can be differentiated.
the comprehension of jokes is not necessarily a prerequisite for humor appreciation, which is in contrast to the traditional view of humor processing.

humor is processed by a complex interaction among the brain networks that are involved in semantic processing, emotional processing, and executive control. (PsycINFO Database Record (c) 2019 APA, all rights reserved)
